description: This file defines the InBinary class in Twig, representing a binary expression node used for 'in' operations within Twig templates. It handles compilation of 'in' filter expressions to PHP code.

classes.name: InBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary expression node for 'in' operator in Twig template syntax, compiling to PHP 'in' checks.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the 'in' operation in Twig, using CoreExtension::inFilter on the left and right operands.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string 'in' representing the operator symbol.
